senses.gloss:
n. (-हं)
A house, a dwelling.
E.
ग a name of GAṆEŚA, इह to desire, affix घञ्; that deity being usually invoked upon laying the foundations of a house.

m. (-र्द्दी)
A lazy or effeminate man, a cotquean.
E.
गेह a house, and नर्द्दिन् who makes a noise: see the next.

m. (-रः)
A slothful and trifling man, one who is unfit for concerns beyond those of the house, a cotquean, a house-hero.
E.
गेह a house, and शूर a hero.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Having a house, a householder, &c.
E.
गेह, and इनि aff.
